original_ai_output.title_zh: 卡诺州市场火灾烧毁四个集装箱和八家商铺
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚卡诺州Gezawa地方政府区Gezawa市场凌晨发生火灾，造成价值数百万奈拉的财产损失，包括四个集装箱和七家临时商铺被完全烧毁。卡诺州消防局发言人Kabiru Jafaru证实了这起事件，称火灾于周一凌晨5时15分左右发生。目前该事件为单一来源报道，具体损失细节尚待进一步核实。

location.raw_text: Gezawa Market in Gezawa Local Government Area of Kano State

key_facts.fact: 卡诺州Gezawa市场凌晨发生火灾，四个集装箱和七家临时商铺被完全烧毁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident happened at about 5:15 am on Monday, with four containers and seven temporary shops completely razed

key_facts.fact: 火灾造成价值数百万奈拉的财产损失
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Properties worth millions of naira were destroyed following another early morning fire outbreak at Gezawa Market

key_facts.fact: 卡诺州消防局发言人Kabiru Jafaru证实了该事件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Public Relations Officer of the Kano State Fire Service, Kabiru Jafaru, confirmed the incident in a statement

key_facts.fact: 火灾于2026年11月2日周一凌晨5时15分左右发生
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: received a distress call on Monday morning, 2nd November 2026, from one Ibrahim Sani, who reported a fire outbreak at Gezawa Market at about 5:15 am

uncertainties: 标题称八家商铺被毁，正文称七家临时商铺被完全烧毁，商铺数量说法不一
目前仅Punch单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
具体损失金额未明确，仅称价值数百万奈拉
